description: How customers paid over a date range, netted of refunds — 'how much came in on card vs cash', 'what did processing fees cost me', 'how much hits my bank account'. Card and each custom processor also report their processing fees and the resulting deposit; cash has no fees. The same aggregation the Financial Summary settlement section uses, so the two always agree.
